Title: Brightwing and Li Li Patch
Subtitle: Technical Alpha patch 0.2.5.29775 (April 15, 2014, article 13789932) introducing playable Heroes Brightwing and Li Li alongside the first account wipe, Custom Games (up to 10 slots, Observers disabled), UI and Shop updates, Haunted Mines Grave Golem scaling, hero balance changes, and bug fixes.
Highlights: Technical Alpha patch 0.2.5.29775 (April 15, 2014, article 13789932) introducing playable Heroes Brightwing and Li Li alongside the first account wipe, Custom Games (up to 10 slots, Observers disabled), UI and Shop updates, Haunted Mines Grave Golem scaling, hero balance changes, and bug fixes.
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Updates]
  • Account Wipe & Rewards: Reset all Technical Alpha accounts to Level 1, wiping XP, leveling/Quest progress, Gold, and Gold purchases; real-money purchases were not reset/refunded in this wipe (planned for future wipes). All 25 heroes made free-to-play through Thursday, April 17 at 3:00 p.m. PDT, plus pre-wipe level Gold/rewards (Levels 1–19: 10,000 Gold; Levels 20–39: 30,000 Gold; Level 40: 30,000 Gold and a Heroes of the Storm lanyard).
  • Custom Games: Added via the Play Screen with up to 10 human/AI lobby slots (Observers disabled); lobby host options (Swap Team, Kick from Lobby, Set A.I. difficulty, Promote to Host) accessed via the wrench icon under allied hero models or right-clicking enemy portraits.
  • Quests & Performance: Reworked most Daily and Hero Quest requirements; added general performance improvements.
  • User Interface: Capped combined daily XP at 1.2 million across Custom Games, Practice, and Co-op (no cap in Versus; Quests now completed only in Versus); moved Daily/Hero Quests from Home screen to Profile screen with a reworked Hero Quest Log; updated Hero Select screen (added Profile button top right, hero info/abilities/skin/mount buttons lower left, and Back button top left replacing Quit); added Uther UI and initial game mode unlock guidance after the Tutorial.
  • Shop: Added Bundles tab; added Monarch Brightwing and Pajamathur Abathur skins and reworked Succubus Kerrigan; allowed purchasing skins directly from a Hero's Skins tab in the Shop in addition to the Skins tab.
  • Gameplay & Talents: Increased Hero movement speed from 4.0 to 4.4; added anti-snowballing measures; made clicking friendly and enemy Heroes easier near Structures (especially Gates) and Minions; reduced Calldown: M.U.L.E. duration from 90 to 60 seconds.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Corrected a number of typos across several aspects of the game.
  • Fixed issues where Daily and Hero Quests were not properly granting credit.
  • Halo effects on the Hero Select screen now properly outline Ronin Zeratul and Witch Doctor character models.
  • In-game target portraits for Muradin, Tyrande, and Zeratul now match their post-game Score Screen portraits.
  • Camera now correctly follows the Dragon Knight in Windowed Mode after enabling Camera Follow while the Dragon Knight is being summoned.
  • Home screen level indicator now more accurately reflects progress toward the next level.
  • Calldown: MULE can now be cast when the casting hero is underground on Haunted Mines.
  • Blood for Blood can no longer target summoned Grave Golems on Haunted Mines.
  • Grave Golem on Haunted Mines is no longer distracted by Abathur's burrowing Toxic Nests.

=== Battlegrounds: Haunted Mines ===
[Updates]
  • Underground Grave Golem scaling Health per minute increased from 625 to 750.

=== Heroes: Arthas ===
[Updates]
  • Basic Attack damage increased from 55 (+5 per level) to 59 (+6 per level).
  • Frost Strike damage increased from 60 (+11 per level) to 80 (+15 per level).
  • Frostmourne Hungers: Basic Attack damage bonus increased from 20% to 40%; duration increased from 4 to 6 seconds.
  • Rune Tap: Now requires 3 stacks for an 8% heal instead of 5 stacks for a 10% heal.

=== Heroes: Barbarian ===
[Updates]
  • Fury (Trait): Removed life steal component; now grants a temporary 10% movement speed bonus on ability cast with additional casts refreshing the duration.
  • Ancient Spear: Cooldown reduced from 15 to 13 seconds.
  • Hammer of the Ancients: Now deals baseline splash damage equal to 25% of base damage (Seismic Slash Talent increases splash damage to 100% of base damage).
  • Whirlwind: Duration reduced from 4 to 3 seconds; damage changed from 320 (+16 per level) to 210 (+21 per level) over its duration; added 20% life steal while active; Fury cost increased from 20 to 25.
  • Leap: Cooldown increased from 40 to 50 seconds; Arreat Crater duration increased from 3 to 4 seconds and can now be cancelled.
  • Wrath of the Berserker: Now generates 25 Fury on cast and costs 4 Fury per second to maintain; cooldown reduced from 100 to 20 seconds (starts after Wrath completes); removed previous movement speed and life steal gains; now grants a 30% bonus to all damage dealt.
  • Talents: Tweaked many Talents to account for the above changes.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Ancient Spear now properly pulls the Barbarian when cast on Grave Golems.

=== Heroes: Brightwing ===
[Updates]
  • New Hero Released — Brightwing, Faerie Dragon.

=== Heroes: Demon Hunter ===
[Updates]
  • Hatred: Reworked so each Basic Attack grants a stack up to 10, granting 3% Attack Speed and 1% Movement Speed per stack; stacks fade at 1 per second rather than all at once; Rancor Talent now increases auto-attack damage at maximum stacks.
  • Strafe: Damage per level increased from 4.5 to 5; search area increased from 7.5 to 10; cooldown increased from 45 to 50 seconds.
  • Rain of Vengeance: Cooldown reduced from 100 to 90 seconds.
  • Siphoning Arrow: Life leech increased from 25% to 50%.

=== Heroes: Diablo ===
[Updates]
  • Apocalypse: Cooldown increased from 100 to 120 seconds; damage reduced from 160 (+12 per level) to 100 (+10 per level).
  • Soulstone: Reworked so stacks cap at 100 and require 100 to resurrect; no longer loses all Soulstone stacks on death, instead losing 100 on resurrection; Endless Death increases max Soulstone stacks to 200 (previously 250).

=== Heroes: E.T.C. ===
[Updates]
  • Mosh Pit: Cooldown increased from 100 to 120 seconds.
  • Rock God!: Damage bonus increased from 40% to 50%.

=== Heroes: Falstad ===
[Updates]
  • Aerial Blitzkrieg: Cooldown increased from 90 to 110 seconds.
  • Flight: Cast time increased from 1.5 to 2 seconds.

=== Heroes: Gazlowe ===
[Updates]
  • Grav-O-Bomb 3000: Cooldown increased from 90 to 110 seconds.

=== Heroes: Kerrigan ===
[Updates]
  • Ultralisk: Movement speed increased from 4.5 to 5.

=== Heroes: Li Li ===
[Updates]
  • New Hero Released — Li Li, World Wanderer.

=== Heroes: Muradin ===
[Updates]
  • Haymaker: Cooldown reduced from 70 to 50 seconds.

=== Heroes: Nova ===
[Updates]
  • Holo Decoy: Sight radius increased from 3 to 6.
  • Wounding Shot: Damage amplification reduced from 30% to 25%.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fast Reload Talent now correctly resets Triple Tap cooldown when an enemy with a post-death state is killed shortly after being struck by Triple Tap.
  • Triple Tap can no longer be absorbed by Abathur's Toxic Nests.

=== Heroes: Raynor ===
[Updates]
  • Base Attack damage changed from 63 (+12 per level) to 63 (+11 per level).
[Bug Fixes]
  • Lead from the Front Trait now properly reduces cooldowns when enemies with post-death states are killed.

=== Heroes: Sgt. Hammer ===
[Updates]
  • Basic Attack starting damage increased from 50 to 55.
  • Tank Mode: Cast time reduced from 1 to 0.5 seconds.

=== Heroes: Stitches ===
[Updates]
  • Putrid Bile: Slow duration increased from 1.125 to 1.5 seconds; search radius increased from 2.5 to 3.

=== Heroes: Tassadar ===
[Updates]
  • Protective Shield: Cooldown increased from 6 to 8 seconds.
  • Health reduced from 850 (+160 per level) to 800 (+145 per level).

=== Heroes: Tychus ===
[Updates]
  • Commandeer Odin: Annihilate starting damage increased from 20 to 70; Ragnarok Missiles starting damage increased from 20 to 70.

=== Heroes: Tyrael ===
[Updates]
  • Righteousness: Shield amount changed from 250 (+25 per level) to 200 (+25 per level); explosion damage increased from 75 (+9 per level) to 90 (+12 per level); explosion radius increased from 2 to 3.
  • Judgment: Cooldown reduced from 100 to 80 seconds.

=== Heroes: Tyrande ===
[Updates]
  • Sentinel: Reveal duration reduced from 8 to 5 seconds.
  • Lunar Flare: Stun duration reduced from 1.25 to 1 second.
  • Shadowstalk: Cooldown reduced from 80 to 60 seconds.

=== Heroes: Zeratul ===
[Updates]
  • Basic Attack damage scaling reduced from 15 to 12 per level.
  • Singularity Bomb: Damage increased from 50 (+12 per level) to 100 (+20 per level).
